text: bhante dhammā . cakkhusmiṃ kho bhikkhave sati cakkhuṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ .pe. jivhāya sati jivhaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ .pe. manamhi sati manaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ . #1 yu. yogakkhemī ... . 2 sī. ma. yu. kiṃ . taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti . aniccaṃ bhante . yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti . dukkhaṃ bhante . yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya
